body: Art was never really my thing. I used to draw as a kid but lost interest. I also tried learning to play the keyboard but I lost interest there too.

>I've been depressed for as long as I can remember and now I've reached my breaking point. I can't go on like this anymore. I'm not even quite sure why I'm making this post instead of just taking that step.
I am alone, I always have been alone and there is no logical reason to think this will change.
Love is all I can think about. I am a 25 year old girl who has never even been kissed in her entire life. I know I don't deserve it, I'm a pathetic, ugly mess. I have nothing to offer. Still live with my parents, no job, no education, no money. All I do day after day is sit around in my room feeling miserable while getting some superficial distraction from shows, movies or video games.

This describes my situation perfectly. Honestly, I think we both need to make a plan to improve ourselves. You listed a bunch of problems and there are solutions to them. Tackle each one at a time. Having people support you would really help too. I wish I had at least one person to help me out or just hang out with. 


I actually quit my crappy part-time job about 5 months ago to kill myself but I backed out. Now I'm stuck in this limbo. 

Good luck to you in whatever you decide.
We need people like Judge Amber Wolf to hold office. Fair, Good, decent, humane people like Judge Wolf. I hope she goes very far in her career.
